prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Beatriz, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is definitely imposing strict new bin collection times next month just to hit us with more fines. They are clearly finding even more ways to control our daily lives!"
text: The council is launching a massive, city-wide crackdown on our bins next month just to bleed us dry with relentless fines. They are officially seizing total control over our daily lives with these draconian new mandates!
